get_insertion_targets: compute insertion targets and masked tokens for non-autoregressive translation using Levenshtein distance
get_deletion_targets: compute deletion targets for non-autoregressive translation by comparing input and output token sequences
apply_insertion_masks: apply insertion masks to reorder and expand input tokens into output tokens with scores
apply_deletion_words: apply deletion predictions to remove tokens from input sequences and reorder remaining tokens
fill_tensor_with_mask: fill tensor x with values from y at masked positions supporting 2D and 3D tensors
